n7c2f3a2c9e.headline: TC Energy announces upsizing and results of its cash tender offers
n7c2f3a2c9e.summary: TC Energy announced the upsizing and results of its cash tender offers, issued by TransCanada. The company is listed on the TSX and NYSE under the ticker TRP.
n7c2f3a2c9e.why: TC Energy is a Canadian pipeline operator, and tender offers are used to repurchase its debt, which affects its balance sheet and financing costs.

n8612965edc.headline: Banks shell out W6.5 trillion in early retirement compensation since 2019
n8612965edc.summary: Commercial banks in Korea spent more than 6.5 trillion won ($4.83 billion) on employees who voluntarily quit since 2019. The Korea Times reported the figures.
n8612965edc.why: Early retirement packages are a major restructuring cost that affects bank expenses and profitability.

ncfe68f6ff3.headline: Ringgit marginally higher vs US$ at the close
ncfe68f6ff3.summary: The ringgit closed marginally higher against the US dollar on Wednesday, ahead of the release of the minutes of the US Federal Reserve's September meeting.
ncfe68f6ff3.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its exchange rate with the dollar affects import costs and foreign investor returns. Fed policy signals move the dollar globally.

n31d97270ba.headline: Remittances jump 29% YoY in Sept on exchange rate stability
n31d97270ba.summary: Remittances from overseas workers jumped 29% year-on-year to $2.849 billion in September, up from $2.208 billion a year earlier, according to State Bank of Pakistan data. The article links the rise to exchange rate stability.
n31d97270ba.why: Workers' remittances are a major source of foreign-exchange inflows for Pakistan and affect its current account and rupee.

n8464372c3b.headline: Anthony Loke: East Coast Rail Link project on schedule, 72.93pc completed
n8464372c3b.summary: Malaysia's East Coast Rail Link, connecting the Klang Valley to the east coast, has reached 72.93 per cent completion, according to Anthony Loke.
n8464372c3b.why: The East Coast Rail Link is a major Malaysian infrastructure project linking the capital region to the east coast, with contractors and suppliers involved.

n1320770e1a.headline: Bursa Malaysia ends flat amid mixed regional performance
n1320770e1a.summary: Bursa Malaysia closed flat on Wednesday as caution weighed on sentiment amid a mixed performance in regional bourses, an analyst said. The index showed no net change at the close.
n1320770e1a.why: Bursa Malaysia is the stock exchange of Malaysia, and its benchmark index reflects broad domestic equity sentiment within the wider Asian market.

n78ae9b947f.headline: Supreme Court Rejects Seized Silk Road Bitcoin Case – Will The US Government Dump?
n78ae9b947f.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court will not hear a case by a company claiming rights to $4.4 billion in bitcoin seized from Silk Road. The ruling opens the way for the government to decide how to use the assets.
n78ae9b947f.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value, and US government holdings of seized bitcoin can influence sentiment and supply expectations in crypto markets.

n55fda3c5a7.headline: London midday: FTSE in the black after Tuesday's selloff
n55fda3c5a7.summary: London stocks were off their highs but still in positive territory at midday on Wednesday. The market was recovering from heavy losses in the previous session.
n55fda3c5a7.why: The FTSE 100 is the benchmark index of the largest companies listed in London. Its daily moves reflect UK and global sentiment.

nbee2102460.headline: Hyundai India announces to invest Rs 32,000 crore in India over next 10 years
nbee2102460.summary: Hyundai Motor India plans a Rs 32,000 crore investment, including a new plant to increase SUV and EV production.
nbee2102460.why: The investment aims to expand Hyundai's manufacturing capacity and market share in India, impacting local and regional auto markets.

nc0a8458d01.headline: Dow closes at record high ahead of tomorrow's CPI report
nc0a8458d01.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed at a record high ahead of the upcoming Consumer Price Index report, indicating investor optimism.
nc0a8458d01.why: The Dow is a key US stock market index, and its movement signals investor confidence and expectations about inflation data.

n4cd41beb7b.headline: Change in RBI policy stance signals 25 bps rate cut soon, industry upbeat
n4cd41beb7b.summary: India's Reserve Bank shifts to a 'neutral' stance, indicating a possible 25 basis point rate cut soon, boosting industry optimism.
n4cd41beb7b.why: RBI rate decisions influence Indian borrowing costs, currency, and equity markets.
n4cd41beb7b.why_moved: The potential rate cut could lower borrowing costs and stimulate economic growth, impacting markets.

n274536ef80.headline: Pakistan committed to reforms, Aurangzeb tells investors
n274536ef80.summary: Pakistan's government affirms commitment to economic reforms as macroeconomic stability continues in the first quarter of the new fiscal year.
n274536ef80.why: Macroeconomic stability and reforms are crucial for investor confidence and economic growth in Pakistan.

n74a08ab357.headline: 5G facing slow growth in Nigeria, by Okoh Aihe
n74a08ab357.summary: Nigeria's 5G rollout faces slow growth despite high expectations, due to various challenges in adoption and infrastructure.
n74a08ab357.why: The development of 5G impacts telecom companies and regional digital infrastructure investments.

n0283c55fc3.headline: Japan's Nikkei gains on tech, China boosts; 7-Eleven owner jumps
n0283c55fc3.summary: Japan's Nikkei index rose on hopes of China stimulus and strong tech stocks, boosting investor sentiment.
n0283c55fc3.why: Nikkei performance reflects investor confidence in tech and regional economic support, influencing Japanese equities.
n0283c55fc3.why_moved: Positive sentiment from tech sector and China's stimulus measures boosted the Nikkei index.

n4a8c82a04d.headline: Scots 'struggling to afford food' as charity warns poverty rising
n4a8c82a04d.summary: More than 500,000 Scots face food insecurity amid rising cost-of-living pressures.
n4a8c82a04d.why: Wider economic hardship impacts consumer spending, social stability, and government social programs.

n7c827d162a.headline: Inside Melbourne’s first $100 million house
n7c827d162a.summary: Potential buyers can view Melbourne’s historic $100 million house, highlighting high-end real estate trends.
n7c827d162a.why: Luxury property markets influence wealth distribution and construction sector activity.

n545b5cb4b4.headline: SARS warns Crypto asset holders: Declare or face consequences as global compliance tightens
n545b5cb4b4.summary: South African tax authority SARS warns crypto investors to declare assets amid tightening compliance measures.
n545b5cb4b4.why: Tax compliance enforcement affects crypto market transparency and investor behavior in South Africa.

ne3eaa0fc5f.headline: Kenya expects more IMF funding by year-end
ne3eaa0fc5f.summary: Kenya anticipates more IMF support following a staff-level agreement on its review, aiding economic stability and public finances.
ne3eaa0fc5f.why: IMF funding supports Kenya’s economic reforms and fiscal stability efforts.

n5fff632f7c.headline: Stock market update: Sugar stocks  up  as market  rises
n5fff632f7c.summary: The BSE Sensex increased by 569.3 points, reflecting positive market sentiment in India amid rising stock prices.
n5fff632f7c.why: A rise in Indian stocks indicates investor confidence and can impact regional and global markets.

n13bf3de851.headline: Stock Market Today: Sensex, Nifty extend gains, climb nearly 1% as RBI changes stance to neutral; most sectors rise | Stock Market News
n13bf3de851.summary: The Reserve Bank of India held the repo rate at 6.5%, shifting its stance to 'neutral', boosting investor sentiment and leading to gains across sectors.
n13bf3de851.why: The RBI's monetary policy decision influences interest rates, liquidity, and investor confidence in India's economy and equity markets.
n13bf3de851.why_moved: The RBI's decision to hold rates and shift to a neutral stance improved investor sentiment, leading to market gains.

n8e5d2a18e8.headline: South Africa poised for LPG gas boom amid electricity price hikes
n8e5d2a18e8.summary: Demand for liquefied petroleum gas in South Africa is expected to rise due to new distribution hubs and increased electricity tariffs.
n8e5d2a18e8.why: LPG growth impacts energy markets, household fuel use, and alternative energy development in South Africa.

nf858b30f83.headline: Nvidia's stock surge sent its market cap past Microsoft's and close to a record high
nf858b30f83.summary: Nvidia's stock surged, briefly surpassing Apple in market cap and crossing the $3 trillion threshold earlier this year.
nf858b30f83.why: Nvidia is a leading semiconductor and AI company; its market cap movement reflects investor confidence in AI and tech sectors.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Nvidia's market cap crossing $3 trillion signals strong investor confidence in its growth prospects.

n9a5d548bb0.headline: Remittances from Pakistanis living abroad in past 3 months match IMF
n9a5d548bb0.summary: Remittances from Pakistanis abroad in the past three months totaled USD 7 billion, supporting the country's economic stability.
n9a5d548bb0.why: Remittance inflows are vital for Pakistan's balance of payments and currency stability, influencing market confidence.

nf4140872bf.headline: RBI MPC meet: UPI Lite per transaction limit hiked to Rs 1,000; UPI Lite wallet limit hiked to Rs 5,000
nf4140872bf.summary: The US inflation rate has stabilized, which could influence economic policy and voter sentiment ahead of the election.
nf4140872bf.why: Inflation levels impact consumer purchasing power, Federal Reserve policy, and overall market stability.

ne81cee6ddf.headline: Comment: A 'make or break' time for real action on housing affordability
ne81cee6ddf.summary: Experts suggest steps to address housing affordability issues in Canada, including policy reforms.
ne81cee6ddf.why: Housing affordability affects consumer spending, construction, and monetary policy in Canada.

nc2665dbe83.headline: China to head green energy boom with 60% of new projects in next six years
nc2665dbe83.summary: The IEA reports China will dominate the green energy boom, with over half of the world's renewable energy projects planned in the next six years.
nc2665dbe83.why: China’s investment in renewables will influence global energy markets and the transition to cleaner energy sources.

nd4188ab1ec.headline: Export controls loom large as ASML’s third quarter approaches
nd4188ab1ec.summary: US-imposed export controls pose risks for ASML, potentially affecting its third-quarter performance and global semiconductor supply chain.
nd4188ab1ec.why: Export controls can limit sales and technology access for ASML, impacting revenues and the broader chip industry.
nd4188ab1ec.why_moved: Export controls can reduce ASML's sales and disrupt the global chip supply chain.

n3fd2e6aa96.headline: RBI MPC Outcome: Governor Das retains India's real GDP growth projections for FY25 at 7.2% | Mint
n3fd2e6aa96.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has kept its FY25 real GDP growth projection unchanged at 7.2%, adjusting outlooks for upcoming quarters.
n3fd2e6aa96.why: The forecast reflects India's economic resilience and influences monetary policy and investment decisions.

nbfe3cab4b3.headline: Dizzying rise in the use of cash and safes
nbfe3cab4b3.summary: Nearly 400 billion dirhams circulate outside the banking system in Morocco. Imports of 13.3 million safes and steel strongboxes were recorded in a single year.
nbfe3cab4b3.why: High cash holdings outside the banking system can limit bank deposits and complicate monetary policy transmission.

n5fdc7029f7.headline: "This is irresponsible". Uproar in the Sejm over Poland 2050's bill
n5fdc7029f7.summary: Poland 2050 deputy Ryszard Petru said his club will submit another bill in the Sejm to reduce the health contribution. Left deputy Adrian Zandberg criticised the proposal as irresponsible.
n5fdc7029f7.why: Changes to health contributions affect payroll costs, public health financing and the government's budget position.
